children: Ujjivan Small Finance Bank announced on Tuesday that its Managing Director and Chief Executive Officer Sanjeev Nautiyal has expressed his desire to seek early retirement in an email dated August 31.
Nautiyal will serve a three-month notice period and will be on leave from September 1 until the end of his notice period on November 30.

"During his stint, the Bank made considerable progress across several key levers including but not limited to significant growth in secured book, healthy deposit franchise, enhanced digital and analytics capabilities, robust risk management & internal control framework," the company said.
Carol Furtado, the bank's current Executive Director, will serve as the interim MD and CEO.
Furtado is a "seasoned" banker with nearly three decades of experience across business, strategy, operations, people and institutional functions.

The company said, "Carol is a key member of the leadership team that laid the foundation and built Ujjivan throughout the journey. She is also recognised for developing leaders, empowering teams and building a culture of ownership and accountability. In her existing role as Executive Director at Ujjivan Small Finance Bank, she has contributed significantly to business growth, transformation and organisational development."
The bank's board will initiate the process of identifying Nautiyal's successor.
Shares of Ujjivan Small Finance Bank were trading 1.16% lower on the BSE at 1:03 pm.

title: Ujjivan SFB CEO Sanjeev Nautiyal seeks early retirement; Carol Furtado to take interim charge, stock down 1.16%
